newsitem.title: DENMARK: Copenhagen Airports says 1996 costs rose.
newsitem.headline: Copenhagen Airports says 1996 costs rose.

text.p: Copenhagen Airports A/S managing director Niels Boserup said the airport's 1996 result would reflect higher costs because of an increase in operations in the year.
"We have had a very big increase in operations. That is both a good thing and a problem," Boserup told Reuters in an interview at the airport.
"The number of operations increased by 11.7 percent. But with so many new operations and so many new aircraft it can be a little bit difficult in the rush to expand your capacity," Boserup said.
"Typically the way you solve this is to increase some of your costs. So we have increased some of our costs," he said.
Passenger volume at Copenhagen international airport rose 7.3 percent to 16.1 million in 1996, the airport said.
The airport is due to publish its 1996 results in March. but the exact date has not been announced.
